from pathlib import Path
import pytest,okto_nexus,okto_nexus_connector,nexus_connector_core

artifacts=json.loads(Path("C:/Users/jpamb/AppData/Local/Temp/r4-session-capability-wheels.json").read_text())

for module,artifact,source in [
(okto_nexus,Path(artifacts["nexus"]["wheel"]),root/"src"),
(okto_nexus_connector,Path(artifacts["connector"]["wheel"]),connector/"src"),
(nexus_connector_core,root/"vendor/wheels/nexus_connector_core-0.2.28.dev0-py3-none-any.whl",None)]:
    package=Path(module.__file__).resolve().parent
    assert "site-packages" in package.parts
    files={}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(artifact) as archive:
        for name in archive.namelist():
            if not name.startswith(module.__name__+"/") or name.endswith("/"): continue
            data=archive.read(name)
            assert (package/name.split("/",1)[1]).read_bytes()==data,name
            if source is not None: assert (source/name).read_bytes()==data,name
            files[name]=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    manifest[module.__name__]={"path":str(package),"wheel":str(artifact),"wheel_sha256":hashlib.sha256(artifact.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"files_sha256":files}
manifest.update(python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform(),isolated=bool(sys.flags.isolated),
scope="Canonical session capability reservation, authority verification, and applied-lease validity; synthetic qualification and selection fixtures, no MCP handler or provider acceptance")
(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/session-capabilities-installed-modules.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
args=["-c","pytest.ini","--rootdir="+str(root/"tests"),"--confcutdir="+str(root/"tests"),"-o","asyncio_mode=auto"]

"contract/test_r4_connection.py","contract/test_wss_r4.py"])

"test_session_capabilities.py","test_ns02.py","test_ns03.py","test_ns09.py","test_ns10.py","test_open_bootstrap.py","test_canonical_controls.py","test_remote_connection.py"])
args.extend(["-q","--tb=line","--junitxml="+str(root/"plans/r4_execution/evidence/session-capabilities-installed.xml")])
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(args))
'

Source regression is Nexus R4, not the complete legacy Nexus suite. Two Connector skips remain nonacceptance.
MCP/native use-case guards, durable protected issuance and launch configuration, automatic runtime lanes/renewal/recovery, embedded/UI/migration/provider gates remain required.

The first venv preparation wrote a requirements file into the target; uv refused it. A fresh empty target and sibling requirements file were used successfully.
whitespace_policy: Raw pip build logs and the initial failed-test XML are retained byte-for-byte. Trailing blank lines in build logs and four traceback lines (85, 96, 1658, 1697) in session-capabilities-initial.xml are excluded from source diff whitespace checks.
